payload.rationale: Channel means (0.74, 0.53, 0.71) are far from zero and stds (0.12–0.18) are small, so zero-centering and unit-variance scaling (standardize) gives the network a well-conditioned input distribution and accelerates convergence versus raw unit-range values. All three geometric augmentations (hflip, vflip, rotate90) are orientation-safe for tissue-type labels: histological structures such as glands, stroma, and necrosis are recognizable regardless of flip or 90° rotation. Applying them train-only (design_evidence=train_only) expands the effective training set by up to 8×, which is especially useful given the moderate class imbalance (ratio 1.63) and the smallest class at ~7.9 k samples, improving generalization without leaking test-time geometry.
